title: Templates
summary: Common templates for communication, devotionals, and evaluations.
content:
Templates

1. Rehearsal Reminder Email

Subject: [Reminder] Rehearsal - {{Date}} at {{Time}}

Hi team,

Quick reminder that rehearsal for {{Scene/Song}} is tonight at {{Location}}.Please arrive 10 minutes early for prayer and setup.

Thank you for serving with excellence!

— {{Director Name}}

2. Post-Production Feedback Form

What went well?

What could improve next time?

Did you feel spiritually encouraged?

Any safety or technical concerns?
